caption:
Toto spent a long day in the Blue Mountains with a big pack. Back home, the shoulders, back and hips are sore.

When the shoulders carry the whole pack, the neck and shoulders can tire quickly. A snug hip belt over the hip bones lets the hips and legs share much of the weight.

Hybi's pack-fit check: hip belt snug, shoulder straps just firm, heaviest items close to your back, and a break each hour. Build distance up gradually.

Arm numbness, pain spreading down a leg, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
